```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(plotly)

# Brand colors from _brand.yml
c_navy    <- "#303e4e"
c_teal    <- "#0f9a7d"
c_blue    <- "#3a6ea5"
c_orange  <- "#d1622a"
c_violet  <- "#6b4fb2"
c_ochre   <- "#a8820a"
c_red     <- "#c1393f"
c_green   <- "#7d9c33"
c_seq_1   <- "#eef1f4"

has_targets <- tryCatch({
  tar_read(composite_rankings)
  TRUE
}, error = function(e) FALSE)

if (has_targets) {
  composite   <- tar_read(composite_rankings)
  benchmark   <- tar_read(benchmark_comparison)
  season_info <- tar_read(current_season_info)
  
  if (!"record" %in% names(composite)) {
    if (!is.null(benchmark$comparison_table) && all(c("wins", "losses") %in% names(benchmark$comparison_table))) {
      rec_lookup <- benchmark$comparison_table |> dplyr::select(team, wins, losses) |> dplyr::distinct()
      composite <- composite |> dplyr::left_join(rec_lookup, by = "team") |>
        dplyr::mutate(record = ifelse(!is.na(wins), paste0(wins, "-", losses), "-"))
    } else {
      composite$record <- "-"
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(benchmark$comparison_table) && nrow(benchmark$comparison_table) > 0) {
    ext_cols <- benchmark$comparison_table |>
      dplyr::select(team, dplyr::any_of(c("rank_colley", "colley_rating", "rank_ap", "ap_delta")))
    composite <- composite |> dplyr::left_join(ext_cols, by = "team")
  } else {
    composite <- composite |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        rank_colley = rank_composite,
        rank_ap = NA_integer_,
        ap_delta = NA_integer_
      )
  }
} else {
  season_info <- list(season = 2024)
  demo_teams <- c(
    "Oregon", "Georgia", "Texas", "Penn State", "Notre Dame", 
    "Ohio State", "Tennessee", "Indiana", "Boise State", "SMU",
    "Arizona State", "Clemson", "Alabama", "Miami", "Ole Miss",
    "South Carolina", "BYU", "Iowa State", "Colorado", "Army",
    "Illinois", "Missouri", "UNLV", "Memphis", "Tulane"
  )
  demo_confs <- c(
    "Big Ten", "SEC", "SEC", "Big Ten", "Independent",
    "Big Ten", "SEC", "Big Ten", "Mountain West", "ACC",
    "Big 12", "ACC", "SEC", "ACC", "SEC",
    "SEC", "Big 12", "Big 12", "Big 12", "AAC",
    "Big Ten", "SEC", "Mountain West", "AAC", "AAC"
  )
  n <- length(demo_teams)
  set.seed(42)
  th <- round(seq(2.45, 0.75, length.out = n), 3)
  dl <- round(seq(21.2, 5.1, length.out = n) + rnorm(n, 0, 1.2), 1)
  om <- round(seq(2.25, 0.68, length.out = n) + rnorm(n, 0, 0.12), 3)
  al <- round(seq(16.8, 3.8, length.out = n) + rnorm(n, 0, 0.8), 1)
  
  p_th <- stats::pnorm(scale(th))
  p_dl <- stats::pnorm(scale(dl))
  p_om <- stats::pnorm(scale(om))
  p_al <- stats::pnorm(scale(al))
  
  comp_idx <- round(0.35 * p_th + 0.25 * p_dl + 0.15 * p_om + 0.25 * p_al, 3)
  r_comp <- rank(-comp_idx)
  r_w <- rank(-th)
  r_p <- rank(-dl)
  r_xw <- rank(-om)
  r_xp <- rank(-al)
  
  composite <- tibble::tibble(
    rank_composite = as.integer(r_comp),
    team = demo_teams,
    conference = demo_confs,
    subdivision_id = 1L,
    record = c("13-0", "11-2", "11-2", "11-2", "11-1",
               "10-2", "10-2", "11-1", "12-1", "11-2",
               "10-2", "9-3", "9-3", "10-2", "9-3",
               "9-3", "10-2", "10-2", "9-3", "11-1",
               "9-3", "9-3", "10-3", "10-2", "9-3"),
    composite_index = comp_idx,
    theta_median = th,
    delta_median = dl,
    omega_median = om,
    alpha_median = al,
    phi_theta = round(p_th, 3),
    phi_delta = round(p_dl, 3),
    phi_omega = round(p_om, 3),
    phi_alpha = round(p_al, 3),
    rank_wld = as.integer(r_w),
    rank_pd = as.integer(r_p),
    rank_xwld = as.integer(r_xw),
    rank_xpd = as.integer(r_xp),
    outcome_luck = as.integer(r_xw - r_w),
    margin_luck = as.integer(r_xp - r_p),
    sb_score = round(seq(18.8, 9.1, length.out = n), 2),
    buchholz_sos = round(seq(8.5, 5.2, length.out = n), 2)
  ) |> dplyr::arrange(rank_composite)
  
  demo_colley_ranks <- c(1, 3, 2, 5, 4, 8, 7, 6, 11, 10, 14, 15, 13, 12, 17, 16, 9, 18, 20, 19, 21, 23, 22, 24, 25)
  demo_ap_ranks <- c(1, 5, 2, 4, 8, 7, 6, 9, 12, 14, 15, 10, 11, 9, 16, 18, 17, 19, 23, 22, 20, 24, 25, NA, NA)

  benchmark <- list(
    comparison_table = tibble::tibble(
      team = composite$team,
      rank_composite = composite$rank_composite,
      wins = as.integer(sub("-.*", "", composite$record)),
      losses = as.integer(sub(".*-", "", composite$record)),
      colley_rating = round(seq(0.94, 0.52, length.out = n), 3),
      rank_colley = demo_colley_ranks,
      rank_ap = demo_ap_ranks
    ) |> dplyr::mutate(ap_delta = ifelse(is.na(rank_ap), NA_integer_, rank_ap - rank_composite)),
    most_underrated = tibble::tibble(
      team = c("Penn State", "Notre Dame", "SMU", "Ohio State", "Boise State"),
      rank_composite = c(4, 5, 10, 6, 9),
      rank_ap = c(6, 8, 14, 7, 12),
      ap_delta = c(2, 3, 4, 1, 3)
    ),
    most_overrated = tibble::tibble(
      team = c("Miami", "Alabama", "Clemson"),
      rank_composite = c(14, 13, 12),
      rank_ap = c(9, 11, 8),
      ap_delta = c(-5, -2, -4)
    )
  )

  composite <- composite |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      benchmark$comparison_table |> dplyr::select(team, rank_colley, rank_ap, ap_delta),
      by = "team"
    )
}
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
### Audit Scope: Season `r season_info$season` Retrospective
Retrospective 4-pipeline Bayesian audit for **Season `r season_info$season`**, comparing realized scoreboard outcomes against net EPA play dominance across the FBS/FCS connectivity graph.
:::

## 1. Executive Summary & Retrospective Philosophy

This is a retrospective evaluative ranking, not a predictive power rating.

- **Predictive Power Ratings (e.g., SP+, FPI):** Forecast what would happen on a neutral field tomorrow.
- **Retrospective Evaluative Rankings (This System):** Score what programs **earned given what occurred**, using posterior end-of-season opponent strength for schedule credit.

Our 4-pipeline architecture decomposes team performance along two orthogonal dimensions:
- **Actual (Scoreboard Realized) vs. Expected (Net EPA Play-by-Play)**
- **Discrete (Game-Level Resumes) vs. Continuous (Point Margins)**

---

## 2. Complete 4-Pipeline Performance Matrix

```{r}
#| label: tbl-full-matrix
#| tbl-cap: "Top 25 Programs: 4-Pipeline Performance Decompositions"
#| echo: false
retro_table <- composite |>
  dplyr::filter(subdivision_id == 1L) |>
  dplyr::slice(1:25) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Rank = rank_composite,
    Team = team,
    Conf = conference,
    Record = record,
    `Composite Index` = composite_index,
    `WLD θ (Resume)` = theta_median,
    `PD δ (Margin)` = delta_median,
    `XWLD ω (Exp W/L)` = omega_median,
    `XPD α (Net EPA)` = alpha_median,
    `Colley` = rank_colley,
    `AP Poll` = ifelse(is.na(rank_ap), "NR", as.character(rank_ap)),
    `AP Δ` = ifelse(is.na(ap_delta), "-", sprintf("%+d", ap_delta)),
    `Outcome Luck` = outcome_luck,
    `SB Score` = sb_score
  )

gt::gt(retro_table, id = "tbl_retro_matrix") |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md(sprintf("**FBS Top 25: Side-by-Side Unified Performance Matrix (Season %d)**", season_info$season)),
    subtitle = sprintf("Season %d • Composite vs. Component Pipelines vs. External Benchmarks", season_info$season)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(label = "Composite Engine", columns = c(`Composite Index`)) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(label = "4 Component Latent Abilities (Parts)", columns = c(`WLD θ (Resume)`, `PD δ (Margin)`, `XWLD ω (Exp W/L)`, `XPD α (Net EPA)`)) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(label = "External Benchmarks", columns = c(`Colley`, `AP Poll`, `AP Δ`)) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(label = "Luck & Tie-Breaks", columns = c(`Outcome Luck`, `SB Score`)) |>
  gtExtras::gt_theme_538(quiet = TRUE) |>
  gt::data_color(
    columns = `Composite Index`,
    palette = c(c_seq_1, c_navy)
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(`WLD θ (Resume)`, `XWLD ω (Exp W/L)`, `SB Score`),
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(`PD δ (Margin)`, `XPD α (Net EPA)`),
    decimals = 1
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = `Composite Index`,
    decimals = 3
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = c(Rank, Team))
  )
```

---

## 3. Resume Luck & Game Control Variance

**Outcome Luck ($\Delta = \text{Rank}_{\text{XWLD}} - \text{Rank}_{\text{WLD}}$)** compares a team's actual discrete rank (WLD) to its expected discrete rank based on net play EPA (XWLD):

- **$\Delta > 0$ (Positive Luck):** Team secured more wins than their down-to-down EPA expected (e.g. winning one-score games or recovering fumbles).
- **$\Delta < 0$ (Negative Luck):** Team dominated the down-to-down metrics but suffered adverse variance in high-leverage moments.

```{r}
#| label: fig-luck-analysis
#| fig-cap: "Outcome Luck Differential Across Top 25 Programs"
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| echo: false
p_luck <- ggplot(composite[1:25, ], aes(x = reorder(team, outcome_luck), y = outcome_luck, fill = outcome_luck > 0)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = c_teal, "FALSE" = c_red), guide = "none") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#222222", linewidth = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Outcome Luck Factor (XWLD Rank - WLD Rank)",
    subtitle = "Positive indicates record exceeded per-play EPA expectations",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Luck Differential (Spots)"
  )

plotly::ggplotly(p_luck)
```

---

## 4. Schedule Difficulty & Opponent Quality Back-Propagation

Games are valued against opponents' final posterior strength, translated into two classical tournament equity metrics:

1. **Sonneborn-Berger (SB) Score:** Rewards defeating high-quality opposition by weighting game results against opponent latent ability $\text{logit}^{-1}(\theta_{\text{opp}})$.
2. **Buchholz (SOS) Rating:** The cumulative schedule difficulty faced across the entire season.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sos-equity
#| tbl-cap: "Top 15 Resumes by Schedule Difficulty and Opponent Quality Earned"
#| echo: false
sos_table <- composite |>
  dplyr::filter(subdivision_id == 1L) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(sb_score)) |>
  dplyr::slice(1:15) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Rank = dplyr::row_number(),
    Team = team,
    Conf = conference,
    Record = record,
    `Bayes Composite Rank` = rank_composite,
    `Sonneborn-Berger Score` = sb_score,
    `Buchholz SOS Rating` = buchholz_sos,
    `WLD Resume (θ)` = theta_median,
    `Net Play EPA (α)` = alpha_median
  )

gt::gt(sos_table, id = "tbl_sos_equity") |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = gt::md(sprintf("**Season %d: Schedule Accomplishment & Opponent Equity Leaders**", season_info$season)),
    subtitle = "Top 15 programs ranked by opponent equity earned (Sonneborn-Berger Score)"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(label = "Tournament Equity Metrics", columns = c(`Sonneborn-Berger Score`, `Buchholz SOS Rating`)) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(label = "Latent Ability Metrics", columns = c(`WLD Resume (θ)`, `Net Play EPA (α)`)) |>
  gtExtras::gt_theme_538(quiet = TRUE) |>
  gt::data_color(
    columns = `Sonneborn-Berger Score`,
    palette = c(c_seq_1, c_navy)
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = c(`Sonneborn-Berger Score`, `Buchholz SOS Rating`, `WLD Resume (θ)`),
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = `Net Play EPA (α)`,
    decimals = 1
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = c(Rank, Team))
  )
```
